name: chart
title: Chart
description: An instrument's graph of a person's numbers: line, area or grouped bars on a sunk plot well with engraved hairlines and tabular axes, read off a readout over the plot (the values turning on the drum) that follows the pointer and the arrow keys, with a crosshair and markers or a plate at the point. Series differ by pattern and marker shape, one signal series in the intent green. Missing values break the line; loading shows skeleton bars, empty and failed say so in the well. Data rises from zero once when it arrives. A computed summary and the numbers as a table, shown with view="table".
base: div role=group (aria-roledescription chart) over HTML and SVG marks; a table for the numbers
